events.title: Every solo deal is now a race
events.summary: Solo deals just got company. Start any solo deal and up to three recorded runs from real players race you on the same cards, clearly labelled as replays. When you win, the win screen shows where you placed, like "#2 of 4". A deal with only one or two recordings gives you fewer; we never invent a run. This changes the Arena queue too. In 1.4.39 a lone player in the queue raced replays. Now the Arena waits for another live player: you keep playing solo, with a field, and you're pulled into the mat

events.title: The Arena is always open
events.summary: Until today, racing in the Arena meant catching another player online at the same moment. Now you can queue any time. If nobody else is queued, the open seats fill with recorded runs from real players, clearly labelled as replays, on the same deal you're playing. Live players are always seated first, and you can choose to wait for a live opponent instead. Also in 1.4.39: a "How to play" card for anyone new to FreeCell, and arrows on the Daily Challenge win screen to step back through past days.

events.title: Race the dev live, every night of Next Fest
events.summary: Every night of Steam Next Fest, from 7 to 8 PM PT / 10 to 11 PM ET, the developer is in the Arena. Grab the free demo, queue up, and race the dev on the identical deal. How it works Everyone gets the same shuffle. Whoever solves it first wins, and every race is timed to the millisecond. What's in the free demo Arena Queue: live races against other players on the same deal The worldwide Daily Challenge Unlimited casual deals at every difficulty How to join Launch the demo and open the Arena Queue

events.title: Hardcore Weekend - one life, in the free demo
events.summary: Hardcore opens in the free demo for one weekend.From Friday morning, September 25 through Sunday night, September 27 - Arizona time, UTC-7, and we don't do daylight saving - Hardcore mode is unlocked in the free demo of MSO FreeCell Arena, and in the free iPhone and Android apps at the same time. It has never been open there before.What Hardcore isNo undo. No hints. No restart. One life.A solver runs in the background while you play, and it isn't there to help you. It's the referee.
